wrote /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-guillaumeloulier-PhpstormProjects-oss-elephc--claude-worktrees-streams-csv-signature/c8dbe38f-1f79-484f-9b83-62bacab9ca56/scratchpad/msg_pufs.txt: fix(streams): php_user_filter::$stream stayed null, so a filter could not reach its own stream

php publishes `$this->stream` for the DURATION of each `filter()` call and
nowhere else. Measured on `php -n` 8.5.6: the property is UNSET inside
`onCreate()`, a live resource inside `filter()`, and NULL again inside
`onClose()`. elephc left it null throughout, so a filter could not call
`stream_get_meta_data($this->stream)` — which the manual's own filter example
does.
